analysis.reasonEn: Maintaining a wait-and-see approach for 3 consecutive trading days. RSI recovered from the low 30s to the 40s but remains in neutral territory, indicating a lack of direction. MACD histogram shows improvement but is still in negative territory, suggesting a weak signal for a bearish reversal. The weekly ADX at 29.2 indicates a clear trend, but on the daily chart, the divergence from the 50-day moving average (94,098 KRW) at -13.66% still suggests potential for further downside. Entered a sideways range between the support at 76,010 KRW and resistance at 86,590 KRW.
